verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a Graph view described as a live, visual map of every Object in a Channel and how they connect, and its linking docs describe tracing how ideas relate. However, nothing in the evidence shows the graph can be filtered to a subset of content. Queries filter content but are documented as Views, not graph filters. Missing for 10: evidence of graph filtering (by type, tag, or relation), detail on interactive navigation within the graph, independent or hands-on corroboration of the graph view.
